messages:
alex: Quick sync — PRD question: can we ship a Minimal Compliance Profile for hosted API that satisfies audits for early customers? Need agreement on acceptance criteria and scope tradeoffs.

maria: Proposal: 'Minimal Compliance Profile' = baseline for GA customers who need SOC2 readiness but not full enterprise bundle. Key pieces: 1) append-only signed event stream, 2) customer-managed KMS support, 3) configurable retention tiers (default 90d), 4) exportable evidence bundle (S3 pre-signed) for auditors, 5) RBAC for export access. Thoughts?

ben: Security POV: Hosted can accept CMK + envelope encryption + rotation policy. For Dedicated/Private customers wanting stronger guarantees, require HSM-backed keys. Must include log signing and tamper-evidence (HMAC chain) and export manifest with checksums.

jordan: Eng estimate (very rough): KMS CMK wiring = 2w, append-only signed stream + export jobs = 3w, retention API + UI = 1.5w. Canary rollout to 10% of orgs first. HSM integration can be decoupled as an enterprise add-on.

maria: Draft acceptance criteria (please review):
- KMS: support customer-provided CMKs; document allowed key policies and key ARN format.
- Audit: every user-facing request must write an event to an append-only stream with a signature header `x-rw-signature` and sequence number.
- Retention: per-customer TTL with defaults: 7d (ephemeral), 90d (standard), 3650d (extended). Default = 90d.
- Export: `POST /v1/evidence/export` returns a pre-signed S3 URL and `manifest.json` containing SHA256 checksums for exported objects; export must complete within 24h or return a job id for polling.
- Docs & tests: integration tests for signing + export, runbook for audit requests, and sample customer config.

alex: Edge cases to call out: partial exports when some events are archived to cold storage; handling cross-region CMKs; emergency key revocation + proof-of-deletion. We should add acceptance items for each.

ben: Quick security checklist to include in PRD:
- Signed events using KMS sign or HSM sign.
- Nonce + monotonic sequence per-customer to detect reordering.
- Export manifest + checksums and tamper-evident manifest signing.
- Logged key rotation events with last-rotation metadata.
- Storage immutability options (WORM / S3 Object Lock) documented for export snapshots.

ops: Operational note: evidence exports could be large and long-running. Need background job with pagination, rate limits, and `export_timeout` config. Also add quotas per-org to prevent abuse.

maria: Small config example to illustrate fields:
```json
{
  "compliance_profile": "minimal",
  "retention_days": 90,
  "cmk": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01",
  "evidence_export": {
    "enabled": true,
    "max_export_days": 3650
  }
}
```

jordan: Proposed rollout plan: update PRD this week, RFC + design review in 2 weeks, prototype for signing+export in staging next sprint, canary to 10% of orgs in following sprint, then GA. Will include toggles so non-GA customers don't pay extra.

alex: Action items: maria - update PRD with acceptance criteria and edge-case matrix; ben - produce security checklist doc + attack surface notes; jordan - firm up effort estimates and canary plan; ops - draft export job SLA and throttling guidance. Target internal gate review on 1965436000. :thumbsup:

security-bot: Automated note: must pass internal compliance scan and e2e audit-export test before gate. See internal guide: https://go/repo/compliance-guides

maria: Thanks all — I'll update PRD and tag the owners. Closing thread for now.
